spans.s: श्रक् vt. 1Ā (pres. श्रकते) To go, to creep.
स्राक् ind. Quickly, speedily.
श्रग् vt. 1P (pres. श्रंगति) To go, to move.
श्रण् vt. 1P, 10U (pres. श्रणति, श्रणयति-ते) To give, to bestow; (generally with वि).
श्रत् ind. A prefix combined with the root धा. See under धा.
श्रथ् (I) vt. 1P (pres. श्रथति) To injure, to kill.
श्रथ् (II) vt. 1P, 1U (pres. श्रथति, श्राथयति-ते) 1. To liberate, to release; 2. to hurt, to kill.
श्रथ् (III) vt. or vi. 1Ā (pres. श्रंथते) 1. To be loose; 2. to loosen, to relax.
श्रथ् (IV) vi. 10U (pres. श्रथयति-ते) 1. To make effort, to be busy; 2. to gladden.
श्रथन n. 1. Loosening, untying; 2. killing, destroying; 3. effort, exertion.

श्रद्धा f. 1. Faith, belief, confidence; 2. composure of mind; 3. belief in divine revelation, श्रद्धेव साक्षाद्विधिनोपपन्ना R.ii.16, Bg.vi.37; 4. respect, reverence; 5. vehement desire, प्राणानाम् सततं प्रयाणपटहश्रद्धा न विश्राम्यति Vikr.Ch.xviii.106.
श्राद्ध (I) a. (f. द्धा) Faithful, believing.
श्राद्ध (II) n. 1. A funeral rite performed in honour of deceased relatives; (it is either नित्य, नैमित्तिक or काम्य); 2. an offering at a Śrāddha.
श्राद्ध (I) a. (f. द्धा) Faithful, believing.
श्रद्धा-जाड्य n. obstinate adherence to one’s faith.
श्रद्धालु (I) a. 1. Faithful, believing; 2. wishing, desirous.
श्रद्धालु (II) f. A pregnant woman longing for anything.
श्रंथ् vt. 9P (pres. श्रथ्नाति) 1. To loosen, to liberate; 2. to gladden, to delight.
श्रंथ m. 1. Loosening, liberating; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
श्रंथन n. 1. Loosening, untying; 2. killing, destroying.
श्रपण n. Causing to boil, boiling.
श्रपणा f. Causing to boil, boiling.
श्रपित a. (f. ता) Boiled or caused to be boiled.
श्रपित a. (f. ता) Boiled or caused to be boiled.
श्रपिता f. Rice-gruel.

श्रम् vi. 4P (pp. श्रांत; pres. श्राम्यति) 1. To make effort, to exert oneself; 2. to perform acts of penance; 3. to be wearied, to be fatigued, प्रदुद्रवतुरन्योन्यं वीरौ शशमतुर्न च Bt.xiv.110; 4. to be distressed, यो बृंदानि त्वरयति पथि श्राम्यतां प्रोषितानाम् Megh.ii.36.With परि-, to be fatigued.With वि-, 1. to take rest, to repose; 2. to cease.
श्रम् Caus. (श्रामयति-ते) With वि-, 1. to take rest, to repose; 2. to cause to alight.

श्रम m. 1. Labour, exertion, toil, अलं महीपाल तव श्रमेण R.ii.34, वंध्यश्रमास्ते सरयूं विगाह्य R.xvi.75, विरम विरम व्यर्थ एष श्रमस्ते Bhartr.iii.66; 2. penance, mortification of the body; 3. military exercise; 4. hard study; 5. weariness, fatigue, विनीताध्वश्रमास्तस्य सिंधुतीरविचेष्टनैः R.iv.67, Megh.i.17, 52; 6. distress.
श्राम m. 1. Time; 2. a month; 3. a temporary shed.
श्रम-अंबु, -जल n. perspiration.
श्रम-अंबु, -जल n. perspiration.
श्रम-साध्य a. to be accomplished by hard labour.
श्रमण (I) a. (f. णा or णी) 1. Labouring, toiling; 2. base, vile.
श्रमण (II) m. 1. An ascetic, a devotee, a religious mendicant; 2. a Buddhist ascetic (as in ब्राह्मणश्रमणम्).
श्रमण (I) a. (f. णा or णी) 1. Labouring, toiling; 2. base, vile.
श्रमणा f. 1. A female mendicant, a female devotee; 2. a handsome woman; 3. a woman of low caste; 4. the Bengal madder.
श्रमण (I) a. (f. णा or णी) 1. Labouring, toiling; 2. base, vile.
श्रमणा f. 1. A female mendicant, a female devotee; 2. a handsome woman; 3. a woman of low caste; 4. the Bengal madder.
श्रंभ् vi. 1Ā (pp. श्रब्ध; pres. श्रंभते) 1. To err; 2. to be inattentive, to be negligent.With वि-, to confide in, to put faith in.
स्रंभ् vt. 1Ā (pp. स्रब्ध; pres. स्रंभते) To entrust, to confide.With वि-, 1. to confide; 2. to be careless.
श्रय m. Refuge, protection, asylum, shelter.
श्राय m. Shelter, protection, refuge.
श्रयण n. Refuge, protection, asylum, shelter.
श्रव m. 1. The ear; 2. the hypotenuse of a triangle.
श्राव m. Hearing, listening.
स्रव m. 1. Oozing, trickling, flowing; 2. a drop, e.g. विपुलौ स्नपयंती सा स्तनौ नेत्रजलस्रवैः; 3. a fountain.
स्राव m. Flow, flowing, oozing.
श्रवण (I) m.n. 1. The ear, वृत्तांतेन श्रवणविषयप्रापिणा तेन भर्तुः R.xiv.87; 2. the hypotenuse of a triangle.
श्रवण (II) m. Name of a lunar asterism consisting of three stars.
श्रवण (III) n. 1. The act of hearing, श्रवण कोमलवर्णराजिः Bh.V.iii.6; 2. studying; 3. fame, glory; 4. wealth; 5. that which is heard, i.e. the Veda.
श्रवणा f. Name of a lunar asterism, (the same as श्रवण II q.v.).
श्रावण (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Relating to the ear; 2. produced under the asterism Śrāvaṇa.
श्रावण (II) m. 1. Name of a lunar month; 2. an impostor; 3. name of a Vaiśya devotee. (See App. II.)
स्रवण n. 1. Oozing, flowing; 2. sweat; 3. urine.
श्रवण-इंद्रिय n. the organ of hearing, the ear.
श्रवण-उदर n. the hollow of the ear.
श्रवण-गोचर (I) a. within the range of hearing.
श्रवण-गोचर (II) m. ear-shot.
श्रवण-पथ, -विषय m. the ear, (reach of the ear), वृत्तांतेन श्रवणविषयप्रापिणा तेन R.xiv.87.
श्रवण-पथ, -विषय m. the ear, (reach of the ear), वृत्तांतेन श्रवणविषयप्रापिणा तेन R.xiv.87.
श्रवण-पालि, -पाली f. the tip of the ear.
श्रवण-पालि, -पाली f. the tip of the ear.
श्रवण-सुभग a. pleasing to the ear.
श्रवस् n. 1. The ear; 2. fame, glory; 3. wealth.
श्रवस्य n. Fame, glory.
श्रवाय्य m. An animal fit for sacrifice.
श्रविष्ठा f. 1. The lunar asterism called Dhaniṣṭhā; 2. that called श्रवणा.
श्रविष्ठा-ज m. the planet Mercury.
श्रा vt. 2P (pp. श्राण or शृत; pres. श्राति; caus. श्रपयति-ते) To cook, to boil, to dress.
श्राण a. (f. णा) 1. Boiled, cooked, prepared; 2. wet, moist.
श्राण a. (f. णा) 1. Boiled, cooked, prepared; 2. wet, moist.
श्राणा f. Rice-gruel.
श्राद्ध-कर्मन् n. funeral ceremony.
श्राद्ध-कृत् m. the performer of a funeral rite.
श्राद्ध-द m. the offerer of a Śrāddha.
श्राद्ध-दिन m.n. the anniversary of the death of a relative to whom a Śrāddha is offered.
श्राद्ध-देव m. 1. a god presiding over funeral rites; 2. an epithet of Yama; 3. a Viśvadeva.
श्राद्ध-देवता f. 1. a god presiding over funeral rites; 2. an epithet of Yama; 3. a Viśvadeva.
श्राद्ध-भुज् m. a deceased ancestor.
श्राद्धिक (I) a. (f. की) Relating to a Śrāddha.
श्राद्धिक (II) n. A present given at a Śrāddha.
श्राद्धिक (I) a. (f. की) Relating to a Śrāddha.
श्राद्धीय a. (f. या) Relating to a Śrāddha.
श्राद्धीय a. (f. या) Relating to a Śrāddha.
श्रांत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Weary, fatigued, exhausted; 2. calmed, tranquillized.
श्रांत (II) m. An ascetic.
श्रांत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Weary, fatigued, exhausted; 2. calmed, tranquillized.
श्रांति f. Fatigue, exhaustion.
श्रावक m. 1. A hearer; 2. a pupil, a disciple; 3. a Buddhist votary; 4. a particular class of Buddhist votaries; 5. a crow.
स्रावक (I) a. (f. विका) Letting flow, pouring out, exuding.
स्रावक (II) n. Black pepper.
श्रावण (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Relating to the ear; 2. produced under the asterism Śrāvaṇa.
श्रावणी f. 1. The day of full-moon in Śrāvaṇa; 2. a religious rite performed on this day.
श्रावणिक (I) a. (f. का) Relating to the month Śrāvaṇa.
श्रावणिक (II) m. The month Śrāvaṇa.
श्रावणिक (I) a. (f. का) Relating to the month Śrāvaṇa.
श्रावस्ति f. Name of a city said to have been founded by king Śrāvasta.
श्रावित a. (f. ता) Told, narrated, said.
श्रावित a. (f. ता) Told, narrated, said.
श्राव्य a. (f. व्या) Plain, audible.
श्राव्य a. (f. व्या) Plain, audible.

स्रंस् vi. 1Ā (pp. स्रस्त; pres. स्रंसते) 1. To fall down, to drop, to slip down, to slip off, to tumble, गांडीवं स्रंसते हस्तात् Bg.i.29, Megh.i.63; 2. to fall asunder, हा हा देवि स्फुटति हृदयं स्रंसते देहबंधः Ut.iii; 3. to hang down; 4. to go.
स्रंस् Caus. (स्रंसयति-ते) to cause to move, to disturb, वातोऽपि नास्रंसयदंशुकानि R.vi.75.With वि-, to cause to drop, (उमा) विस्रंसयंती नवकर्णिकारम् K.S.iii.62.
स्रंस m. Falling, slipping.
स्रंसन n. The act of bringing down.
स्रंसिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Falling down, slipping down, hanging down, being loosened, बंधे स्रंसिनि चैकहस्तयमिताः पर्याकुला मूर्धजाः Sak.i.; 2. depending, pendulous.
स्रंसिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Falling down, slipping down, hanging down, being loosened, बंधे स्रंसिनि चैकहस्तयमिताः पर्याकुला मूर्धजाः Sak.i.; 2. depending, pendulous.
स्रंह् vt. 1Ā (pres. स्रंहते) To confide, to trust.
स्रग्विन् a. (f. णी; compar. स्रजीयस्; super. स्रजिष्ठ) Bearing a chaplet, आमुक्ताभरणः स्रग्वी हंसचिह्नदुकूलवान् R.xvii.25.
स्रग्विन् a. (f. णी; compar. स्रजीयस्; super. स्रजिष्ठ) Bearing a chaplet, आमुक्ताभरणः स्रग्वी हंसचिह्नदुकूलवान् R.xvii.25.
स्रज् f. 1. A chaplet, a wreath of flowers, स्रजमपि शिरस्यंधः क्षिप्तां धुनोत्यहिशंकया Sak.vii.; 2. a garland in general.
स्रग्दाम n. the fillet or tie of a garland.
स्रग्धरा f. a species of metre. (See App. I.)
स्रज्वा f. A rope, a cord, a string.
स्रद्धू f. Breaking wind downwards.
स्रवत् a. (f. स्रवंती) Flowing, dripping, distilling, वापीष्विव स्रवंतीषु वनेषूपवनेष्विव R.xvii.64.
स्रवत् a. (f. स्रवंती) Flowing, dripping, distilling, वापीष्विव स्रवंतीषु वनेषूपवनेष्विव R.xvii.64.
स्रवंती f. A stream, a river, (स्रवंती निम्नगापगा Am.i.10.30).
स्रवत्-गर्भा f. 1. a woman that miscarries; 2. a cow miscarrying by accident.
स्रष्टृ m. 1. An epithet of Brahman (m.), या सृष्टिः स्रष्टुराद्या Sak.i.; 2. a maker, author, creator; 3. an epithet of Śiva.

स्रस्त a. (f. स्ता) 1. Fallen, dropped, slipped off, कनकवलयं स्रस्तं स्रस्तं मया प्रतिसार्यते Sak.iii.; 2. loosened; 3. hanging down; 4. drooping, स्रस्तांसावतिमात्रलोहिततलौ बाहू Sak.i.; 5. let go, relaxed; 6. separated.

स्रस्त a. (f. स्ता) 1. Fallen, dropped, slipped off, कनकवलयं स्रस्तं स्रस्तं मया प्रतिसार्यते Sak.iii.; 2. loosened; 3. hanging down; 4. drooping, स्रस्तांसावतिमात्रलोहिततलौ बाहू Sak.i.; 5. let go, relaxed; 6. separated.
स्रस्त-अंग a. 1. having the limbs relaxed; 2. swooning, fainting.
स्रस्तर n. A couch or sofa for reclining, गोश्वोष्टयानप्रासादस्रस्तरेषु कटेषु च M.ii.204.
स्रावक (I) a. (f. विका) Letting flow, pouring out, exuding.
